channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 3 new fellowships - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Film London: The FLAMIN Fellowship 2026
    https://filmlondon.org.uk/resource/apply-to-the-flamin-fellowship
    Film London (FLAMIN - Film London Artists' Moving Image Network), with Arts Council England · deadline Closed 01 Jun 2026 · GBP 2,500 project-development bursary per artist, plus a year-long programme of monthly in-person workshops, 1:1 sessions with a production advisor, screening and promotion, and a peer community. Stage-2 interviewees also receive a GBP 100 interview fee. No application fee.
  • British Library: Creative Fellowship 2026 - Remote Ecologies (Art, Climate and the Amazon)
    https://www.bl.uk/stories/blogs/posts/remote-ecologies-art-climate-and-the-amazon-at-the-british-library
    The British Library · deadline Closed 02 Jun 2026 · GBP 7,500 stipend plus up to GBP 3,000 production budget.
  • British Council 90th Anniversary Research Fellowships at IASH 2027 (Edinburgh)
    https://www.iash.ed.ac.uk/british-council-90th-anniversary-research-fellowships
    Institute for Advanced Studies in the Humanities (IASH), University of Edinburgh, in partnership with the British Council · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · GBP 2,500 per month bursary for 12 months, plus travel expenses, dedicated office space, University of Edinburgh email and library access, a University mentor, weekly Fellows' Lunch, work-in-progress seminars, full calendar of Institute and College events, and opportunities to participate in or design funded workshops and colloquia. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new fellowships - week of 04 May 2026
item.description:
• Cavendish Arts Science Fellowship 2026-2027 (Girton College, Cambridge)
    https://www.cavendish-artscience.org.uk/open-call/
    Cavendish Arts Science (Cavendish Laboratory) in partnership with Girton College, University of Cambridge · deadline Closed 16 May 2026 · Stipend £10,000 (inclusive of taxes) plus rent-free accommodation and meals at Girton College during the residency, £10,000 production budget for new work, and up to £3,000 travel budget. Total cash and in-kind value approximately £23,000 plus accommodation and meals.
  • Understanding Society Data Research Fellowships (May 2026 call)
    https://www.understandingsociety.ac.uk/research/fellowships/call-fellowships/
    Understanding Society (Institute for Social and Economic Research, University of Essex) · deadline Closed 27 May 2026 · Up to £70,000 per fellowship for staff costs and dissemination-related activities (no indirects). Salary, NI and pension funded at 100% for research-only contracts; for research-and-teaching contracts the fellowship funds backfill at the most junior lecturer point. Third-sector applicants additionally get £5,000 of an academic collaborator's salary covered.
  • Serpentine: Future Art Ecosystems R&D Fellowship - Art x Convergence (2026-2027)
    https://www.serpentinegalleries.org/whats-on/future-art-ecosystems-rd-fellowship-art-x-convergence/
    Serpentine Arts Technologies (Future Art Ecosystems) · deadline Closed 07 Jun 2026 · £10,000 award per fellow (4 fellows: individuals or collectives), plus travel and accommodation support for the three London intensives, plus specialist seminars, workshops and structured peer learning through the cohort.
